craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of marshalled examples — parity and fencing. Fancied-spread refused; So-it-stands seal. Rejected: (a) fancied→fancied-in-name kept whole → already kept. (b) cutting seal → killed: seal closes helpers. Read aloud: THERE, IF the-CON-scious-ONE's-SPREAD … DOES-ord-er-HOLD ev-ery-WHERE.

lines: There, if the conscious one's spread be fancied in name —
yet not by that alone does order hold everywhere.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra buddhimato nāma prasaro yadi kalpyate na tāvataiva sarvatra vyavasthā ghaṭate tathā

reads_against.argmap: Does imagined spread order all? → Imagined spread of the conscious doesn't alone order everywhere.
c1_essence: Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11).
The hetu fenced, others sifting, the whole Lord-made; helpers' strange way opened, pictured, and bounded; fancied spread refused (vv12-18).
